partners.mechanism_chain: TSEN54 (HGNC:11772) —DISRUPTS→ ER protein folding (GO:0006457); NUP133 (HGNC:14155) —DISRUPTS→ ER protein folding (GO:0006457); ER protein folding (GO:0006457) —LEADS_TO→ ER-associated degradation (ERAD) (GO:0030433); ER-associated degradation (ERAD) (GO:0030433) —LEADS_TO→ Pontocerebellar hypoplasia (HP:0001304); ER-associated degradation (ERAD) (GO:0030433) —LEADS_TO→ Nephrotic syndrome (HP:0000079).
